met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over northwest Uttar Pradesh between 1.5 to 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough in upper tropospheric westerlies roughly along Long. 82°E to the north of Lat. 22°N between 5.8 to 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over southwest Bay of Bengal off south Sri Lanka now lies over Comorin area coasts & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough in easterlies now runs from the Comorin area coasts neighbourhood to Westcentral Bay of Bengal across Sri Lanka, Gulf of Mannar, Southwest Bay of Bengal extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over North Pakistan & adjoining Jammu at 3.1 km above means sea level with a trough aloft roughly along Long. 67°E to the north of Lat. 32°N at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Rajasthan & neighbourhood now lies over central parts of Rajasthan at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Northeast Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Bihar at 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from East Uttar Pradesh to north Coastal Andhra Pradesh across East Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
